text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning and clear communication. First, time management is essential. Create a schedule and break large tasks into smaller steps so you can track your progress. Second, learn to prioritize: focus on the most important tasks first and do not waste time on things that can wait. Third, manage the scope of your work. If a project becomes too big, discuss reducing it with your team instead of missing the deadline. Finally, communicate openly. Tell colleagues or managers early if you have a problem, because hiding difficulties only makes things worse. With these simple habits, deadlines become much easier to handle.
